title: A Second-Order Dynamical System for Solving Generalized Inverse Mixed Variational Inequality problems
summary: In this paper, we study a class of generalized inverse mixed variational inequality problems (GIMVIPs). We propose a novel projection-based second-order time-varying dynamical system for solving GIMVIPs. Under the assumptions that the underlying operators are strongly monotone and Lipschitz continuous, we establish the existence and uniqueness of solution trajectories and prove their global exponential convergence to the unique solution of the GIMVIP.
